lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca8Sm4Mo4O24 (Ca2SmMoO6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Mo and Sm centers coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ca adopts a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement; O centers bridge one Mo and one Sm. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Mo and Sm octahedra and face-sharing between Ca 12-vertex polyhedra and both Mo and Sm octahedra.
